segments.speaker: Vikram (Acme)
segments.text: Thanks for making time. We are looking at roughly fifty seats for the support team.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: For fifty seats our team plan comes to 40,000 rupees per month, billed annually.

segments.speaker: Vikram (Acme)
segments.text: That works in principle, but we cannot roll out without single sign-on.

segments.speaker: Rahul
segments.text: SSO with Okta and Google is planned for the first quarter. I can share the roadmap.

segments.speaker: Vikram (Acme)
segments.text: Good. Could we start smaller while we wait for SSO?

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: Yes. Let's agree on a pilot with ten seats starting on the first of December.

segments.speaker: Vikram (Acme)
segments.text: Agreed, a ten seat pilot from December first.

segments.speaker: Rahul
segments.text: I will send the SSO roadmap by Wednesday.

segments.speaker: Aman
segments.text: And I will send the pilot contract by Friday.

segments.speaker: Vikram (Acme)
segments.text: I need to confirm the budget with our finance team before signing.
